name: Ferienwohnung Arnold
beschreibung: The Arnold holiday apartment is located in the municipality of Schwoich, in a quiet location in the Unterinntal above Kufstein. From here, the center of Kufstein and the hiking trails in the Kaisergebirge can be reached quickly by car. The apartment has a fully equipped kitchen, a separate bedroom, and a private entrance. A private parking space is available. The quiet, rural surroundings define the atmosphere of the accommodation. The apartment is ideal for couples and small families looking for a hiking holiday or a starting point for the Wilder Kaiser ski area. The nearby town of Kufstein also offers shopping opportunities and a rail connection.
